cognates.label: Major:
cognates.text:
Major: Economics courses – 113 and 114 (highly recommended by the end of sophomore year;
213; 214; 257 or MAT 217 or PSY 217; 321 or BUSN 323; 461 (culminating experience); any four others,
only one of which can be at the 100-level.
Cognate courses: MAT 113 or MAT 121.
Total of 11 major courses, plus 1 cognate = 12.
